thread:
jordan: FYI — got an ask from a large gov customer via sales. They want a packaged Terraform module + SCIM provisioning flow + marketplace listing. Mentioned compliance window in 6 weeks.
emily: Copy — ticket summary: 'Provisioning + SSO/SCIM + terraform module for self-serve in marketplace'. Customer also wants role mappings documented.
intake-bot: New intake created IN-4271 by emily. Tags: needs-clarification, potential-dedicated, marketplace-integration.
ravi: @jordan can you confirm whether this is behind our Private deployment (VPC) requirement? Gov tends to require VPC + KMS.
jordan: Good call. Sales said on call they want self-serve via marketplace first, but must support VPC-based deployment later. For MVP: public marketplace listing that points to our Dedicated onboarding + docs for VPC option.
sofia: For scope: propose MVP = Terraform module that calls our marketplace provisioning API + SCIM connector config template + basic role mapping example. Exclude HSM/KMS work for phase 2.
nana: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Terraform module published to registry, 2) SCIM connector example in repo with tests (end-to-end repro), 3) Marketplace listing with operational playbook, 4) Security checklist completed.
emily: Customer impact: medium-high, volume unknown. Sales asks for estimate to include in contracting.
ravi: Rough eng estimate: 2 sprints for module + docs + test harness, + 1 sprint for marketplace packaging + QA. Need a PM to scope docs and contract language.
jordan: @ana please own product acceptance + launch criteria. We'll tag backlog item with: integration/marketplace, sdk:terraform, identity:scim, priority:customer-request.
nana: Quick proto config snippet for role mapping we can reuse:
```
resource "redwood_marketplace_provision" "acme" {
  org_name = "acme-corp"
  plan = "dedicated"
  enable_scim = true
}
```
sofia: +1. Also add a test matrix for: public marketplace flow, dedicated onboarding, and VPC follow-up.
jordan: Next steps: 1) ana to create JIRA IN-4271 with acceptance criteria, 2) ravi to add initial estimate in ticket, 3) emily to confirm compliance window with customer, 4) sofia to draft module README. Aim to decide prioritization at Friday roadmap sync. :eyes:
emily: I'll confirm compliance window by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
